prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" personal injury lawyer, but top-rated firms for truck accidents in Dallas include Mullen & Mullen Law Firm and Ted Lyon Law, both known for decades of local experience and contingency fee structures. Mullen & Mullen Law Firm +1
Because commercial truck accidents involve complex federal regulations (like Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration rules) and multiple liable parties, choosing an attorney who specifically handles large commercial vehicle litigation is essential. Rad Law Firm +1
Experience & Services: Serving North Texas for over 43 years with attorneys Shane Mullen, Joseph Morrison, and Regis Mullen offering over 104 years of combined experience. They provide direct attorney access and free in-house accident investigators.
Fees & Costs: Discounted 29% pre-suit contingency fee; $0 unless they recover money for you.
Contact: Free consultations available at 214-747-5240.
Federal Regulation Knowledge: Must understand FMCSA compliance, driver hours-of-service logs, and black box data preservation.
Rapid Response Investigation: The ability to deploy investigators within 72 hours to preserve critical evidence before it disappears.
Identified Liable Parties: Ability to pursue claims against the driver, the trucking company, cargo loaders, and maintenance providers. Haque Law, PLLC +2
If you can share the severity of the injuries or whether fault is being disputed, I can help you narrow down which firm matches your specific situation.
